pricing.notes: FLAGGED. enhancv.com/pricing is geo-priced in EUR from this network and opens on the Pro Quarterly card: €58.51 billed every three months, i.e. €19.50/month, discounted 32% from €86.28. Clicking the Pro Monthly tab did not repaint the card in a scripted browser session, so the month-to-month rate could not be read. Our basis list has no quarterly code, so this records the effective monthly cost of a non-monthly billing period. The page title advertises "starting from $16.50".
